entities.name: Fire Eye
entities.description: Elder Viashino Bey of Shiv in 3346 AR, who made a deal with Urza over the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Came to Shiv to take control of the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: Ancient machinery of Shiv producing Thran-metal viashino.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Island ruled by the Viashino Bey.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Artifact creature whom Fire Eye wanted to possess.

events.summary: Urza travels to Shiv and is led to Fire Eye after resistance from Rhammidarigaaz.
events.quote: he was led to Fire Eye after some resistance from the viashino 's champion dragon

events.summary: Fire Eye agrees to Urza's proposal on condition Gherridarigaaz leave Shiv and he possess Karn; Urza agrees.
events.quote: Urza agreed to the deal on both counts.

relations.quote: Fire Eye was the Viashino Bey of Shiv in 3346 AR
